name: OK: cap sentence
text: Under the Model Tenancy Act, 2021 a deposit is capped at two months' rent [RENT-DEPOSIT].

name: OK: 15-day notice + summary suit
text: Send a legal notice with a 15-day deadline, then a summary suit under Order XXXVII of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 may be available [RENT-REMEDY].

name: OK: s.138 with its Act
text: Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 gives you 30 days from the return memo to send a demand notice [NI-138].

name: OK: limitation 2 years
text: Under Section 69 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 a complaint must normally be filed within two years [CPA-LIMIT].

name: OK: labour code (2026 law)
text: Wages are governed by the Code on Wages, 2019, which replaced the Payment of Wages Act, 1936 [WAGES].

name: OK: repealed Act NOT treated as current is a KB job, guard only checks traceability
text: Gratuity is now under the Code on Social Security, 2020 [GRATUITY].
